description: Canonical chrome-blue robot companion mascot: over-ear headphones, dark glossy screen face with glowing cyan eyes, CC shield chest emblem, volt-orange + teal joint accents. One identity, three intensity registers (expressive / standard / restrained) per CINEMATIC-LAYER-PLAN.md §1.
generator: Higgsfield Nano Banana Pro (nano_banana_2), reference-locked to watchful.webp for identity consistency; keyed to transparency locally

poses.use: DEFAULT pose. Kai Watch header ('Kai is watching N things for you'), calm analyst-at-desk energy, general standard Club surfaces.
Lesson guide (Learning World), onboarding step explainers, Kai Daily 'presenting' banner, concept intros.
Correct-answer / belt-earned / streak / challenge-win moments, lesson completion, XP cinematics.
Loading / analyzing states, 'Kai is thinking', prediction suspense, quiz-in-progress.
Empty / degraded / offline states: 'Kai is temporarily unavailable' — failure still feels like a companion.
Directing attention / call-to-action, 'Make your first move', pointing to a ticker or next step.
Kai's-read / analysis contexts, alert detail 'Kai's read', reviewing a chart or tablet.
Alert / Near-Trigger states, unusual-volume flags, 'heads up' watch notifications (urgent but friendly).
Greeting / welcome — onboarding step 1, first-run welcome, splash companion, family household welcome.
Approval / confirmation / 'nice work' micro-reactions, positive feedback on submissions.
Kid-expressive delight — kid surfaces, playful reactions, fun reveals (kids register only).
Small static avatar / badge crop (512x512, centered bust). Kai sheet trigger + FAB, alert-author byline, dense data UI where a full illustration is banned.
